evidence: src/infrastructure/InMemoryOrderRepository.ts: class InMemoryOrderRepository implements OrderRepository, a domain port implemented by an infrastructure adapter
save() and findById() only call Map set/get, so they are pure storage concerns
findByState() filters stored orders using the domain accessor getStateValue(), which is a repository query and not a business rule

parsedVerdict.reasoning: The file is an in-memory persistence adapter. There is no business logic, presentation or application orchestration in the file.
